primary_claim: Theorem 1: uniform first-order coefficient of the constrained radial energy infimum
model: Stationary comoving Alcubierre metric, one-component shift, v=1/10
profiles: All globally C2 monotone radial profiles equal to 1 on r<=1 and 0 on r>=R; zero first and second endpoint derivatives; no uniform higher-derivative bound

parameters.limit: eta tends to infinity with wall width in [1/2,2]

constraint: Euclidean spectral norm of E/v^2 <= eta at every wall radius and angle; E is the electric part of the full Riemann tensor
proof_status: Analytic proof; no optimizer existence assumed
finite_evidence: 18 exact rational enclosures with outward decimal rounding; separate 120-digit quadrature corroboration

formalization.statement_strength: Weaker consequence of Theorem 1 with existential error constants

publication_status: Local publication candidate; no public release or DOI assigned
not_claimed: identifying the Eulerian slice-energy integral with ADM mass
the same energy bound for nonmonotone or nonradial profiles, multicomponent shifts, or general divergence-free shifts
